subject: Oceanography
title: Polar Bears
description: A fast breakdown of Polar Bears for builders.

hook.text: Polar bears are marine mammals—they spend most of their lives on sea ice, hunting seals from above.

buildup.text: They wait at breathing holes where ringed seals surface—a patient hunting strategy perfected over millennia.

discovery.text: A polar bear's fur is transparent, not white—each hollow hair scatters light, creating the white appearance.

twist.text: Less sea ice means less hunting platform—bears must swim longer distances and go hungrier between meals.

climax.text: Some populations have declined 40%—bears are thinner, produce fewer cubs, and face starvation.

punchline.text: No ice means no seals—and no future for polar bears.

quiz.question: Why do polar bears depend on sea ice?
options: They hunt seals from the ice surface
They eat the ice for fresh water
